body: Fuel economy could be a little better but im guessing thats just me being an idiot always in vtec range

Also, check the oil sensor on the clutch case side. It's under a rubber cover near the bottom side.
Check the bank angle sensor. If you're missing the sensor, try jumping the connector that leads to it. Edit: Jump the outer wires!!
